items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 8 at 12:29PM AKDT until October 11 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 65 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Windy Pass.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Friday to 1 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds could blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Use extra caution when driving, especially if operating a high
profile vehicle. Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 8 at 12:29PM AKDT until October 11 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 35 to 45 mph with gusts up to 70 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Isabel Pass North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Friday to 7 AM AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds may blow down trees and power lines.
Travel will be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
People should avoid being outside in forested areas. Use caution
if you must drive.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 8 at 12:27PM AKDT until October 9 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 30 to 40 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Point Hope.

* WHEN...From 10 AM Thursday to 7 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property
and cause power outages. Travel may be difficult.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown
around or damaged by the wind.

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 8 at 12:21PM AKDT until October 10 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations up to 10 to 14
inches for areas of elevation. Winds occasionally gusting as high
as 45 mph.

* WHERE...Noatak Valley and South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 10 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Areas of blowing snow
could significantly reduce visibility.
items.areas: South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range; Noatak Valley
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water with
you in case of an emergency.
